parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Send the same key again to retry safely: once the first try has succeeded, a repeat gets its answer and nothing runs again, even after an undo. A copy sent while the first is running waits up to 5 seconds for its answer, then is refused with 409 to try again. A refused or failed command keeps nothing, so a copy or a retry runs it again. Keys are per person. The same key with a different request is refused with 409, and a malformed key with 400.
